scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
